assessment.summary: The claim is an attribution claim — that Klobuchar said these words — and both an independent debate transcript and a Politifact fact-check confirm she stated this exact sentence during the February 25, 2020 Charleston debate.

evidence.finding: The debate transcript in Charleston records Klobuchar saying: "While we are all sitting here debating, Wisconsin has kicked hundreds of thousands of people off of their voting rolls."
Politifact identifies the speaker as Amy Klobuchar stating the quoted sentence on February 25, 2020 in a debate.

Politifact's fact-check evaluated the underlying factual claim and found it inaccurate (the targeted Wisconsin voters were not actually removed), but this concerns the statement's substance, not the attribution.

assertions.assertion: "US Senator Amy Klobuchar said While we are all sitting here debating, Wisconsin has kicked hundreds of thousands of people off of their voting rolls"

contradictions: If the claim were interpreted as asserting the substance of the statement (that Wisconsin actually removed hundreds of thousands of voters), S1 P2 would support FALSE; the text of the claim, however, is an attribution, which the records directly establish.
next_queries: Search for the February 25, 2020 debate video or CBS/WISN broadcast records to independently confirm the quote beyond the UCSB transcript (which may share an underlying source with Politifact).
